en: Right, you lot! Orders from the top: we move out to Mt. Pyre. Now!
A splendid battle. May I have your number? My Manectric would enjoy hearing how you fare.
Register Walter in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Very good. I shall telephone now and then, at a polite hour.
Quite all right. Perhaps another day.
You're good at spotting things. Let's keep in touch, so I can tell you how my Kecleon is doing.
Register Jessica in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Lovely! Don't be surprised if I call out of nowhere.
Oh well. My Kecleon will just have to hide its sulk.
I want a rematch someday. Let's swap numbers, and I'll call when I'm ready.
Register Cristin in the PokéNav's Match Call?
Done! Next time, I won't hold back.
Then I'll find you myself. Count on it.
